snippet.title: Spooky Express trailer | Thinky Direct 2025
snippet.description:
Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park! Transport monsters to their destinations — but don’t let them bite the passengers or you’ll have a grave problem.

Catch this brand new trailer for Spooky Express, a spooky follow-up to Cosmic Express from Draknek & Friends.

Spooky Express in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/spooky-express/

Spooky Express on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkgames.com/direct/
